title: 第1347章 大好河山第1346章 最后一战2
slug: 从哥布林开始骑马砍杀
content_zh:
（感谢.神经病kl.的打赏加更12）
另一边，厄忒斯的指挥部内，他跟迅拉，以及科索三个孩子待在一起，不停的安抚着三人。
这时，一个军官走进来，小声在他耳边汇报道：
“元帅已经确认了，整座鹰眼山上只剩科索一个活口，他抵抗的非常凶，展现出的实力应该有超凡水平。
好在我们的兵力多，这会儿他已经被堵在鹰眼山最后的山头上，正在那里负隅顽抗。
最后的山头上有很多重武器，很多隧道，我们的士兵冲进去强攻，可能会死很多人。
所以我们的工兵决定，让死灵法师复活僵尸，背炸药包进去自爆，这样可以安全的解决科索。
元帅，前线攻坚小队派人回来问，还要不要再劝降？”
科索毕竟是月神国的统治者，现在被逼到绝路，鹰眼山最后那个小山包上，已经没有周转的空间了。
只要把100多个死灵僵尸全部冲进隧道山洞，他必死无疑！
但是前线的攻坚官兵也有点顾忌，他们害怕大人物们对科索还有什么别的安排。
所以在攻坚的最后关头，前线还是派人回来问厄忒斯这个元帅的意见。
厄忒斯还没发表意见，军官的话就被迅拉，以及三个孩子给听到了。
迅拉的眼睛里出现泪水，她的前夫，这就走到尽头了吗？
他的三个孩子则是表情各异，大哥科达拉直接哭求道：
“教父，我的父亲可是你的好兄弟呀，能不能求求你放他一命！
再劝降他一次吧，我求求你了，再劝他一次，他肯定会屈服的！”
大哥跪下了，二哥也跪下了，三弟科索普咬了咬牙，也跪下了。
厄忒斯脸上出现为难的神色，他是一个感性和理性并存的人。
在国家大事方面，理性占据大脑，他在整个战争的过程中，和科索打的那叫一个凶猛，丝毫没有放水。

甚至来说如今的局面，早在十几年前他就促成了。
因为当时他离开兽人世界，非常了解兽人的文化以及战斗力，他根据这些了解，训练了龙虎军这支专门针对虎兽人的战斗部队。
一整个战役下来，把科索逼到如今的境地，正是他的手笔！
但如今科索大势已去，2000多人被打的只剩一人，还在鹰眼山最后的小山包包上坚守。
这个时候局面已经完全可控，厄忒斯的理性开始下线，感性开始上来。
三个教子往自己面前一跪，厄忒斯立马就范。
他赶忙走上前，把三个孩子扶起来。
“好了孩子们，我知道了，我亲自上山一趟，劝说你们的父亲投降，你们就在这里等我吧。”
厄忒斯的理性知道，科索绝对不会投降的，可奈何现在感性心理上头。
他希望科索不要像他预想的那样坚强，希望他能暴露出自己以前从未发现的软弱。
可他自己都不知道，如果科索真这般的软弱的话，那科索还是科索吗？
content_en:
(Thanks to Crazy Kl. for the reward, plus update 12)
On the other side, in Ertes' headquarters, he stayed with Xunla and the three children of Corso, constantly comforting the three of them.
At this time, an officer walked in and whispered a report in his ear:
"The marshal has confirmed that there is only one living person left in the entire Eagle Eye Mountain: Coso. He resisted very fiercely, and the strength he displayed should be extraordinary.
Fortunately, we have more troops. At this moment, he has been blocked on the last hill of Eagle Eye Mountain, where he is resisting stubbornly.
There are many heavy weapons and tunnels on the last hill. If our soldiers rush in and attack, many people may die.
Therefore, our engineers decided to let the necromancer resurrect the zombies and carry explosive bags in to explode themselves. This way, Corso can be eliminated safely.
Marshal, the front-line attack team sent someone back to ask if we want to persuade you to surrender again? "
After all, Corso is the ruler of the Moon God Kingdom, and now he is forced to a dead end. There is no room for turnover on the last hill of Eagle Eye Mountain.
As long as more than 100 undead zombies are rushed into the tunnel cave, he will definitely die!
But the officers and soldiers on the front line were also a little wary. They were afraid that the big shots had other arrangements for Corso.
Therefore, at the last moment of the attack, the frontline sent people back to ask Marshal Etes for his opinion.
Before Etes could express his opinion, the officer's words were heard by Xunla and the three children.
Tears appeared in Xun La's eyes. Is this the end of her ex-husband?
His three children had different expressions. The eldest brother Kodala cried directly and begged:
"Godfather, my father is your good brother, can you please let him live!
Please persuade him to surrender one more time, I beg you, persuade him one more time and he will definitely give in! "
The eldest brother knelt down, the second brother also knelt down, and the third brother Kosopp gritted his teeth and knelt down too.
A confused look appeared on Etes's face. He is a person who coexists with sensibility and rationality.
When it comes to national affairs, reason occupies the brain. During the entire war, he fought fiercely with Corso without letting go at all.
Even speaking of the current situation, he contributed to it more than ten years ago.
Because he left the orc world at that time, he had a very good understanding of the culture and combat effectiveness of the orcs. Based on this understanding, he trained the Dragon Tiger Army, a combat force specifically targeting the tiger orcs.
After the entire battle, it was his handiwork that forced Corso to his current situation!
But now the situation in Corso is over. Only one of the more than 2,000 people was beaten, and he is still holding on to the last hillock of Eagle Eye Mountain.
At this time, the situation was completely under control. Ertes' rationality began to go offline and his sensibility began to rise.
The three godsons knelt down in front of him, and Etes obeyed immediately.
He hurriedly stepped forward and helped the three children up.
"Okay kids, I understand. I will go up to the mountain myself and persuade your father to surrender. You just wait for me here."
Etes knew rationally that Corso would never surrender, but now his emotional psychology got the best of him.
He hoped that Corso wouldn't be as strong as he expected, that he would reveal a weakness in himself that he had never seen before.
But he didn't even know that if Corso was really so weak, would Corso still be Corso?
